title: El caballo
goal: Turn down a horse ride without making it awkward
culture: Reasons work better than refusals, and praising the animal costs nothing and is probably true. You have done the four-noes version of this at the hammock stall; this is the gentler one.

beats.good: The first no. You have done this at the hammock stall and it works the same way here.

beats.es: ¡Es manso! Suba, no le pasa nada.
beats.good: A reason he cannot argue with, and it happens to be true. Reasons work far better than refusals in this country.

beats.es: Por eso mismo. Yo lo llevo despacio.
beats.en: He is a fine-looking horse, though.
beats.good: Praise the animal. It costs nothing, it is probably true, and it turns a refusal into a conversation he can walk away from happily.

beats.es: ¿Verdad que sí? Es mío desde potrillo.
beats.good: Otro día, one more time. By now you know it is a real maybe rather than a brush-off, which is exactly why it works.
